basis.governing_question: What strategy should Banco Horizonte follow for its digital channels?

sub_questions.question: How do Banco Horizonte's digital channels perform today for customers and for the bank?
What do customers expect from digital channels, and what do competitors offer?
Which strategic options for the digital channels are open to the bank, and how do they compare?
What target channel model and roadmap does the chosen option require?

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Digital channel assessed (journeys, usage data, performance against peers)

phase_work.why: Interviews with the two stakeholders first, then the three channels assessed side by side; customer research and competitor benchmarking run alongside.

work.unit: Strategic options built and compared on agreed criteria
Target channel model and roadmap for the chosen option

phase_work.why: Options are compared first, then the target model and roadmap are built for the chosen option; no library archetype applies.

sizing.levers: Comparing two strategic options instead of more, and a high-level roadmap instead of a detailed one, would shorten Design most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how Banco Horizonte's digital channels perform today and how they compare with customer needs and competitor offers.

gate.label: Priorities for design
gate.decision: Which digital channel priorities go forward into strategy design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define strategic options for the digital channels and set out the target model and roadmap for the chosen one.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the digital channel strategy and roadmap as final?

architect_notes: Settle the engagement length: it is not given, so the 10 to 14 weeks in total are an estimate from the work.
Three digital channels are assumed, not stated; confirm the count with the client, because it sets the Diagnostic length.
No library archetype fits a digital channel strategy, so phases and work pieces are planned from scratch, not from the firm's method.
Customer and competitor research runs inside the Diagnostic phase rather than as a separate Research phase, since one decision closes both.
